--- START OF FILE .gitignore ---

# =========================
# OS Generated Files
# =========================
.DS_Store
.DS_Store?
._*
.Spotlight-V100
.Trashes
ehthumbs.db
Thumbs.db
Desktop.ini

# =========================
# Obsidian Specific
# =========================
# We want to commit the .obsidian folder so the team shares the same 
# themes, templates, and plugin settings. 
# However, we MUST ignore local workspace states so we don't constantly 
# overwrite each other's open tabs and graph views in Git.
.obsidian/workspace
.obsidian/workspace.json
.obsidian/workspace-mobile.json
.obsidian/graph.json

# =========================
# Jekyll & GitHub Pages
# =========================
# Ignore local build folders if someone tests the site locally using Ruby/Jekyll
_site/
.sass-cache/
.jekyll-cache/
.jekyll-metadata
vendor/

# =========================
# Security & AI Credentials
# =========================
# CRITICAL: Prevent developers from accidentally committing their API keys 
# while testing the Python/Node snippets from the tutorials.
.env
.env.*
*.pem
*secret*
*credentials.json

# =========================
# Developer Environments
# =========================
# Just in case the team adds local test scripts to the repo
__pycache__/
*.py[cod]
*$py.class
.venv/
venv/
env/
node_modules/
npm-debug.log
yarn-error.log
